# Acceptance Criteria Canonical Full Bundle

## 4.1 Ma trận truy xuất

| Mã AC | Kịch bản | Trace |
|---|---|---|
| AC-AST-001 | Given an asset officer has create permission, when they submit valid asset data, then the system stores one unique asset code. | BRQ-01, BR-001, FR-AST-001, F01, US-AST-001 |
| AC-TRN-001 | Given an asset has transfer history, when the asset officer opens asset detail, then the transfer history is visible within 2 seconds. | BRQ-02, FR-TRN-001, F02, US-TRN-001 |
